label: Takahashi et al. (2005) / Zhao et al. (2006) / Fukushima et al. (2006)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Takahashi et al. (2005) / Zhao et al. (2006) / Fukushima et al. (2006)

site.anchor_note: Five classes confirmed, named after the published coefficients CH (hard rock) and C1-C4; the physical definitions are not given in the appendix.

class_definitions.site_class_1: SC I rock, NEHRP A+B, 600 < Vs30 <= 1100 m/s, T < 0.2 s (C1)
class_definitions.site_class_2: SC II hard soil, NEHRP C, 300 < Vs30 <= 600 m/s, 0.2 <= T < 0.4 s (C2)
class_definitions.site_class_3: SC III medium soil, NEHRP D, 200 < Vs30 <= 300 m/s, 0.4 <= T < 0.6 s (C3)
class_definitions.site_class_4: SC IV soft soil, NEHRP E+F, Vs30 <= 200 m/s, T >= 0.6 s (C4)

mechanism.anchor_note: SR = 0.251 is a reverse-faulting flag applied to crustal events. The reference (non-reverse) class is not named.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for ONE named version of this family. PGA coefficients (a, b, c, d, e, SR/SI/SS/SSL, CH, C1-C4, hc) and both sigma components are now available, but the version they belong to must be confirmed.

implementation_notes: Three branches (crustal/interface/intraslab) in one family - cross-branch tests at identical inputs.
The focal-depth effect and the published depth threshold are part of the form.
The easiest model in the set to corrupt by mixing coefficient sets across versions.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Crustal + interface + intraslab in one family.

depth_branch.note: RESOLVED: the published depth threshold hc is 15 km. This is the focal-depth term in the source/path function.

parameters.version_note: The anchor block's coefficient naming (SR / SI / SS / SSL / CH / C1-C4, hc = 15 km) matches the Zhao et al. (2006) formulation rather than Takahashi (2005) or Fukushima (2006). Treat that as probable, not settled, and confirm against the paper before recording a version.

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmin 0* km (rrup)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax 300* km (rrup)
resolution_provenance.distance.approximate: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): values starred
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code G; OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/zhao_2006.py declares IMC.GEOMETRIC_MEAN
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/zhao_2006.py coefficient table; period count and range (20 periods, 0.05-5 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked. This is the Zhao et al. (2006) grid; the family's version question is unchanged.
